name: Labuan Bajo
blurb: Labuan Bajo functions as a fishing town and gateway located at the western end of Flores, Indonesia, serving as a base for boat trips into Komodo National Park. Recent online conversation notes local seismic activity, including multiple earthquakes and aftershocks near the region.

positive: Scenic harbor views, pink sand beaches, and mountain sunrises
Convenient access via the international airport with flights from Denpasar, Bali
Great experiences exploring local marine life, snorkeling, and boat charters
negative: Frequent earthquakes and shallow aftershocks reported in the area
Water receding observed during seismic events, raising concerns
Challenging boat trip logistics that limit hiking time on the islands

quotes.text: Labuan Bajo, Indonesia — Labuan Bajo is a fishing town situated at the western end of the large island of Flores in Indonesia.
